nora_csm: Heads up - Lumin Health wants a short APAC pilot (48h) starting tonight. They asked for a temporary QPS bump to 800 and CIDR allowlist to route to apac-sg edge.

sam_ops: OK. Please share CIDRs and whether they use mTLS or special headers. Any PHI notes?

nora_csm: CIDRs: 45.33.50.0/24 and 45.33.51.64/26. No mTLS, they rely on TLS. They will include X-Cust-ID header for tenant routing. Some requests contain hashed PHI; retention rules apply.

jia_infra: Region pin to apac-sg and set separate caps: embeddings=600 qps, chat=200 qps? Embeddings can spike.

matt_se: Agreed. Add header exemption for X-Cust-ID. Also enable audit log retention for the 48h window.

nora_csm: TTL 48h, auto-revoke. Renewal in ~8 weeks; pilot metrics will feed renewal conversation.

ops-bot: Request RQ-9922 created: customer=lumin, env=prod-pilot, region=apac-sg, qps_caps={embeddings:600,chat:200}, cidrs=[45.33.50.0/24,45.33.51.64/26], header_exemptions=[X-Cust-ID], ttl=48h, compliance=audit-logs-on. ETA ~30m.

jia_infra: Change APPLIED (RQ-9922). KV cache warmup started. Monitoring alert: p50 > 150ms OR embeddings p95 > 700ms.

nora_csm: Sent config to customer. They acknowledge and will run perf tests at 01:30 UTC. I'll add results to account health doc and flag for renewal impact. :white_check_mark:
